settings.label: Can I change what is in my box?
settings.text: Yes. Swap scents, add products or remove them until the day before your box ships.

settings.label: What if I have too much soap?
settings.text: Skip a delivery or snooze for up to six months. No fees and no guilt.

settings.label: Do I get anything for subscribing?
settings.text: Free shipping, a discount on every order and early access to limited bars.

settings.label: How do I cancel?
settings.text: Open your account, select your subscription and cancel. It takes less time than lathering up.
